label: Precision Field Manual
about: The look of the Precision Field Manual, as data. A designer edits a value here and runs `node build.mjs`, or tries it live with ?skinset={"d3":{"color.union.fill":"#2d6bc4"}} (a token marked layout:true sizes the footprint the layout engine reserves, so it only takes effect after a rebuild). Every colour is #rrggbb, every length is CSS px at 1x on a 2 px grid.

tokens.name: color.plate
tokens.doc: Plate of a mark: the flat surface under the code. Opaque, so the text contrast is a property of the plate and never of the ground.

tokens.name: color.plateHover
tokens.doc: Plate while the pointer rests on the mark (eased).

tokens.name: color.keyline
tokens.doc: The one-pixel line around a mark. It is the only ink that is not data: it keeps a dark plate readable on a dark photograph.

tokens.name: color.text
tokens.doc: Code, name and the strength gauge on the plate. 15:1 on the plate.

tokens.name: color.textMuted
tokens.doc: The tail of a mark (the count of an aggregate), in the regular weight. Secondary detail.

tokens.name: color.glyph
tokens.doc: The arm symbol on a side colour.

tokens.name: color.ringLight
tokens.doc: Selection ring, inner line, and the ring of a pin.

tokens.name: color.ringDark
tokens.doc: Selection ring, outer line, and the dark underlay of a leader and a pin: together with the light line it holds on any ground.

tokens.name: color.underlay
tokens.doc: The dark underlay of a leader, a pin and the members of an aggregate: it holds a light line on any ground. On the day ground it is the paper colour, so the dark line colours hold.

tokens.name: color.union.fill
tokens.doc: Union cell: the side, when the keyframe is fresh. White glyph on it: 4.9:1 or better.

tokens.name: color.union.old
tokens.doc: Union cell once its keyframe is a whole battle day old: the same hue washed toward grey (the one provisional device).

tokens.name: color.union.ink
tokens.doc: Union as a line colour on the ground: pin, leader, the members of an aggregate.

tokens.name: color.confederate.fill
tokens.doc: Confederate cell, fresh keyframe. White glyph on it: 4.9:1 or better.

tokens.name: color.confederate.old
tokens.doc: Confederate cell once its keyframe is a whole battle day old.

tokens.name: color.confederate.ink
tokens.doc: Confederate as a line colour on the ground.

tokens.name: color.contested.fill
tokens.doc: Ochre cell of a unit whose side the data cannot settle (the id prefix and the state code disagree). Never a side colour.

tokens.name: color.contested.old
tokens.doc: Contested cell once its keyframe is a whole day old.

tokens.name: color.contested.ink
tokens.doc: Contested as a line colour on the ground.

tokens.name: color.contested.glyph
tokens.doc: Glyph ink on the ochre cell (dark: white would not reach 4.5:1 on ochre).

tokens.name: color.contested.hatch
tokens.doc: Hatching of the contested cell.

tokens.name: size.plate.unit
tokens.doc: Height of the plate of a regiment, battery or battalion; the cell is a square of the same side. 11 px type.

tokens.name: size.plate.brigade
tokens.doc: Plate height of a brigade record (formation tier, 13 px type).

tokens.name: size.plate.division
tokens.doc: Plate height of a division record.

tokens.name: size.plate.corps
tokens.doc: Plate height of a corps record.

tokens.name: size.plate.agg
tokens.doc: Plate height of an aggregate (the formation mark a crowd merges into).

tokens.name: size.tab
tokens.doc: Height of the tab above a formation, which carries the echelon marks (II, X, XX, XXX) the way APP-6 puts them above the frame.

tokens.name: size.stack
tokens.doc: Offset of the plate behind an aggregate: more than one record.

tokens.name: size.padL
tokens.doc: Space between the cell and the code.

tokens.name: size.padR
tokens.doc: Space after the last character of the mark.

tokens.name: size.tailGap
tokens.doc: Space between the code and its tail (the count of an aggregate).

tokens.name: type.small
tokens.doc: The small type size: unit codes, tails, secondary text. 11 px is the floor of the language.

tokens.name: type.large
tokens.doc: The large type size: formation marks and the primary text of every card. There is no third size.

tokens.name: gauge.h
tokens.doc: Thickness of the strength gauge: the foot of the plate, flush with its edges.

tokens.name: gauge.segments
tokens.doc: Ticks of the strength gauge at the quartiles: it reads as a state and not as a measurement.

tokens.name: shape.radius
tokens.doc: Corner radius of every mark, ring and card: the one radius of the language.

tokens.name: shape.hatch
tokens.doc: Pitch of the hatching on a contested cell.

tokens.name: glyph.stroke
tokens.doc: Stroke of the arm symbols and the echelon marks.

tokens.name: alpha.keyline
tokens.doc: Opacity of the keyline.

tokens.name: alpha.keylineHover
tokens.doc: Opacity of the keyline under the pointer.

tokens.name: alpha.track
tokens.doc: Opacity of the empty part of the strength gauge.

tokens.name: alpha.gauge
tokens.doc: Opacity of the filled part of the strength gauge.

tokens.name: alpha.leader
tokens.doc: Opacity of the leader line of a displaced mark.

tokens.name: alpha.leaderUnder
tokens.doc: Opacity of the dark underlay of a leader.

tokens.name: form.nameZoom
tokens.doc: Zoom from which a mark grows from its code to the unit's full name (the same object, wider). Below it only the selected mark is grown.

tokens.name: form.nameHyst
tokens.doc: Hysteresis of that threshold in zoom steps: a camera that rests on the threshold does not flicker between forms.

tokens.name: form.nameOnSelect
tokens.doc: The selected mark always grows to its full name, whatever the zoom (the layout makes room for it).

tokens.name: motion.selectMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the selection ring.

tokens.name: motion.hoverMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the hover response.

tokens.name: motion.growMs
tokens.doc: Cross-fade of the code into the full name while a mark grows.
